title: Noor de Bruijn
text: I am a data scientist and consultant based in Melbourne. I recently completed my PhD research at the University of Melbourne, where I applied natural language processing (NLP) to large-scale workplace text data. I also ran my own research and analytics firm for six years, working with clients in media, market research and e-commerce. My strengths: technical depth, practical problem-solving, and clear communication.

Tools & Technologies

Languages: Python, SQL, R, Bash
Data analysis & modelling: pandas, NumPy, statsmodels
Machine learning & NLP: scikit-learn, PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers, spaCy
Statistics: experimental design and A/B testing, multilevel and longitudinal models, regression and mediation analysis, SEM
Infrastructure: Git, AWS, Saturn Cloud (GPU computing)
Visualisation & reporting: Tableau, Matplotlib, Seaborn, LaTeX

title: Projects
text:
COVID-19: Why Do People Follow the Rules?


Lead analyst on a four-country study of 1M+ longitudinal data points, with findings featured in reports by the Dutch public health institute (RIVM).

















Emerce 100: Ranking Dutch Digital Agencies


Five years of research behind a national ranking of Dutch digital agencies, rated by 20,000+ professionals.

















Food Delivery: An AI Agent for Ops Teams


An AI agent that answers operations questions about food deliveries in plain English, using SQL, a delivery-time model and charts as tools.

















Melbourne’s Food Scene: Who Stays Open?


An interactive dashboard of twenty years of City of Melbourne census data, showing where cafés and restaurants open, close and survive.

















Performance Reviews at Scale with NLP


Applying NLP to 2M+ performance feedback records, in collaboration with Culture Amp.
